content: Recent work on convolutional neural network architectures showed that they are competitive with recurrent architectures even on tasks where modeling long-range dependencies is critical, such as language modeling BIBREF0 , machine translation BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 and speech synthesis BIBREF3 . In end-to-end speech recognition however, recurrent architectures are still prevalent for acoustic and/or language modeling BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 , BIBREF8 .
